title.narrative: As a result of UNICEF&39;s support, the Government of Cambodia successfully transformed the emergency COVID-19 cash transfer scheme into a sustainable, integrated social cash transfer program. Additionally, pathways to social protection were enhanced through increased access to TVET-based skills training and decent jobs for vulnerable groups. The Disability Identification Mechanism (DIM) was strengthened and expanded, laying the foundation for the rollout of comprehensive social support measures for people with disabilities, aligned with the new Family Package and other social services.
